text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one error in a slice bound in ml/train/loop.py caused loss divergence in the training loop.","The loss divergence issue only appeared on the first request after a cold start.","The issue could be reproduced by training two epochs on the small split.","The symptom of the loss divergence was a loss curve that turned upward and never returned.","The nightly rollup had been failing to match source counts for 28 days before the fix was applied.","The fix involved correcting the slice bound and adding a property test around it to prevent regression.","The fix was submitted as PR #2945 on the fix/loss-divergence-1 branch.","The buggy code was in the same section of ml/train/loop.py as earlier loss divergence work."]}
